import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem compact_set_nested_open_shrink {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  (K U : Set X) (hK : IsCompact K) (hU : IsOpen U) (hKU : K ⊆ U) :
  ∃ V W : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ closure V ⊆ W ∧
    IsOpen W ∧ IsCompact (closure W) ∧ closure W ⊆ U := by
  obtain ⟨K₁, hK₁, hKK₁, hK₁U⟩ := exists_compact_between hK hU hKU
  obtain ⟨K₂, hK₂, hKK₂, hK₂K₁⟩ := exists_compact_between hK isOpen_interior hKK₁
  have h1 : closure (interior K₂) ⊆ interior K₁ :=
    (closure_mono interior_subset).trans (hK₂.isClosed.closure_eq.subset.trans hK₂K₁)
  have h2 : IsCompact (closure (interior K₁)) :=
    hK₁.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_closure ((closure_mono interior_subset).trans hK₁.isClosed.closure_eq.subset)
  have h3 : closure (interior K₁) ⊆ U :=
    (closure_mono interior_subset).trans (hK₁.isClosed.closure_eq.subset.trans hK₁U)
  exact ⟨interior K₂, interior K₁, isOpen_interior, hKK₂, h1, isOpen_interior, h2, h3⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem compact_set_nested_open_shrink {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X]
  (K U : Set X) (hK : IsCompact K) (hU : IsOpen U) (hKU : K ⊆ U) :
  ∃ V W : Set X, IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ closure V ⊆ W ∧
    IsOpen W ∧ IsCompact (closure W) ∧ closure W ⊆ U := by
  have hW_exists : ∃ W, IsOpen W ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ closure W ⊆ U ∧ IsCompact (closure W) := by
    first
    | exact hK.exists_open_with_compact_closure hU hKU
    | exact IsCompact.exists_open_with_compact_closure hK hU hKU
    | exact?
    | aesop
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hKW, h1, h2⟩ := hW_exists
  have hWU : closure W ⊆ U := by aesop
  have hWc : IsCompact (closure W) := by aesop
  have hV_exists : ∃ V, IsOpen V ∧ K ⊆ V ∧ closure V ⊆ W ∧ IsCompact (closure V) := by
    first
    | exact hK.exists_open_with_compact_closure hWo hKW
    | exact IsCompact.exists_open_with_compact_closure hK hWo hKW
    | exact?
    | aesop
  obtain ⟨V, hVo, hKV, h3, h4⟩ := hV_exists
  have hVW : closure V ⊆ W := by aesop
  exact ⟨V, W, hVo, hKV, hVW, hWo, hWc, hWU⟩
